title: AG Gradnja – Construction Company Website
valueProposition: A multilingual business website built to present construction services clearly and convert visitors into clients.
paragraph: A multilingual business website built to present construction services clearly and convert visitors into clients.
challenge: The company needed a professional online presence that could communicate credibility across markets, showcase completed work, and perform well for local and international search traffic.
solution: Designed and developed a production website in Next.js with a clean service structure, project gallery, multilingual support (SR, EN, DE, TR, AR), image optimization, and SEO-ready page architecture.
outcome: A fast, scalable marketing site that strengthens brand trust and gives AG Gradnja a clear digital foundation for growth.
keyFeatures: Multilingual site structure (SR, EN, DE, TR, AR)
Responsive layouts for mobile and desktop
paragraph2: Built for real-world production use with responsive layouts, clear information architecture, and performance-focused frontend patterns that keep the experience sharp on every device.
seoTitle: AG Gradnja Construction Website | Next.js Multilingual Business Site
seoDescription: Case study: multilingual Next.js website for AG Gradnja — construction services, project showcase, SEO, and conversion-focused UX by Mehmed Muric.
